candidats.description: View of a quarter of a vaulted ceiling. At lower left corner, a fountain with a seabird creature sitting upon a vase, water spewing from its beak. Plants and a dolphin surround the fountain. Along left edge, various decorative scenes including a reclining female nude figure and Poseidon with a trident above horses. Along right edge, a figure sitting beneath a tree against an architectural fragment of a wall, a man holding a staff beneath a rocaille arch made up of sea creature forms, and a view of two ships at sea; in the nearest ship, a figure holds a swath of drapery, using it as a sail. candidats.description: Atherton's Grand Hotel A color scheme of creams and browns, beige and the palest of blues setting off spacious rooms and giving wide stairways of Queensland woods a deeper background; that is one of the first impressions as one walks into the new Grand Hotel at Atherton. The commodious lounge is very cool and the keynote of the furnishings is simplicity. The ceiling of fibrous plaster is ornamented with a pattern of grape vines and fruit - fitting tribute to Bacchus. ... candidats.description: On Castle Hill in Dudley is this former cinema - it was an Odeon. 1930s Art Deco style. <a href=" http://heritage.elettra.co.uk/artdeco/profile.php?building=dudley " rel="noreferrer nofollow">Odeon Dudley</a> The Odeon Dudley was built on a plot opposite Dudley Castle and opened on 28 July 1937. The cinema was designed by Harry Weedon and Budge Reid of the Weedon Partnership in the Art Deco style. candidats.titre: File:De winkel van boekhandelaar Pieter Meijer Warnars op de Vijgendam in Amsterdam Rijksmuseum SK-A-662.jpeg
candidats.description: Interieur van de winkel van boekhandelaar Pieter Meijer Warnars op de Vijgendam te Amsterdam. Links een klant aan de balie waarachter twee winkelbediendes staan. Op de vloer staat een pers. Rechts een zittende schrijvende man. Links en rechts staan tegen de muren hoge kasten met boeken. Tegen het plafond een reeks schilderijen van triomfwagens. Door de deuropening zicht op straat met voorbijgangers en een paard.
categories: Paintings by Johannes Jelgerhuis in the Rijksmuseum Amsterdam

candidats.description: The home has a partial Raumplan which places vestibule, office, lounge on the ground floor and dining and kitchen and bedrooms and bathrooms on an upper level. The house employs floor to ceiling fenestration in its lounge framing dramatic 180 degree views from an elevated position on top of a hill crest. An elevated dining level looks down onto the lounge with inbuilt seating placed three steps lower then dining level. A built-in cabinet separates the dining level from the lounge level.
